from_speaker: no reason to think that any of them are logically insolvable in principle
our_interpretation: The post defines AGI as a system capable of doing almost any cognitive task a human can do.
The statement about logical solvability is his reason for the forecast, rather than a future conditional antecedent.
Someday supplies no deadline. Passing a particular benchmark is insufficient to establish the full claim.
criteria.support_condition: A publicly demonstrated system shows human-level competence across a sufficiently broad range of cognitive tasks to meet the post's AGI definition, with credible independent evaluation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive impossibility result establishes that systems meeting this definition cannot be achieved. Continued delay alone cannot contradict an unlimited forecast.
